name: Calculator Galore Calculators
author: calculatorgalore

sections.description:
Add any of these 59 calculators to a post or page. The ones marked † are in English for now (see Languages below).

Math

  • Scientific Calculator: a full scientific keypad (trigonometry in degrees or radians, logs, powers and roots, factorials, nCr and nPr) with a history, a Table tab for tables of values, a Standard or classic Handheld view, and full screen.
  • Graphing Calculator †: plot equations like y = x² or x² + y² = 25, read roots, vertex and crossings, fit a line to a table of points, with sliders, graph settings, three text sizes and full screen.
  • Percentage Calculator: percent of a number, what percent one number is of another, percentage change, and adding or subtracting a percentage.
  • Fraction Calculator †: add, subtract, multiply or divide fractions and mixed numbers, in lowest terms and as a decimal.
  • Decimal to Fraction Calculator †: any decimal, repeating ones too, as a fraction or mixed number, or rounded to the nearest 16th.
  • Proportion Calculator: solves A/B = C/D for the missing value by cross multiplication.
  • Ratio Calculator: simplifies a ratio of two or three numbers, or splits a total in a given ratio.
  • Area Calculator †: area and perimeter of 12 common shapes, from circles and triangles to trapezoids and ellipses, with the working.
  • Average Calculator †: mean, median, mode, range, sum and count of a list of numbers.
  • Standard Deviation Calculator †: sample and population standard deviation, variance and mean, every step shown.
  • GCF Calculator † and LCM Calculator †: greatest common factor and least common multiple, shown three ways.
  • Factoring Calculator †: factor quadratics by the ac method, or list the factors and prime factorization of a number.
  • Square Root Calculator †: square roots to 10 digits and the simplified radical form, like √72 = 6√2.
  • Slope Calculator †: slope from two points or rise and run, the line’s equation, angle and percent grade, with a graph of the points and line that redraws as you type.
  • Volume Calculator †: volume of a box, cylinder, sphere, cone or pyramid, in liters and gallons too, with a to-scale drawing of the shape that redraws as you type.

Dates and time

  • Date Calculator: the days between two dates, or a date plus or minus years, months, weeks and days.
  • Age Calculator †: exact age in years, months and days, in weeks and days, the next birthday and the weekday you were born.
  • Time Duration Calculator: hours and minutes between two times (with an unpaid break and optional dates), or a time plus or minus hours and minutes.
  • Time Card Calculator †: a week of start, end and break times, total and decimal hours, overtime and gross pay, with a printable timesheet.

School

  • GPA Calculator: GPA from letter grades and credits, weighted for honors, AP and IB, by semester, with a cumulative GPA.
  • Weighted Grade Calculator †: your class grade from weighted categories, even when some aren’t graded yet.
  • Final Exam Calculator †: the score you need on the final to reach the grade you want.

Home and construction

  • Concrete Calculator: cubic yards for a slab, footing or round column, with extra for waste and an optional cost.
  • Square Footage Calculator: the area of rectangles, circles and triangles, added up, with an optional cost per square foot.
  • Cubic Yard Calculator †, Gravel Calculator † and Mulch Calculator †: how much soil, gravel or mulch to order, in cubic yards, tons or bags.
  • Paint Calculator †: gallons of paint for walls and ceiling, minus doors and windows, for any number of coats.
  • Tile Calculator †: tiles and boxes for a floor or wall, with grout joints and waste.
  • Fence Calculator †: posts, rails and pickets for a wood fence, gates included, and the cost.
  • Roof Pitch Calculator †: pitch, angle and slope from rise and run, the pitch factor and roof area.
  • Board Foot Calculator †: board feet for one board or a lumber list, with the cost.

Finance

  • Mortgage Calculator †: the full monthly payment with property tax, insurance, PMI and HOA dues, when PMI ends, with charts.
  • Amortization Calculator: the monthly payment on a loan, total interest, extra payments, a yearly and monthly schedule and two charts.
  • Personal Loan Calculator † and HELOC Calculator †: payments, total cost and APR, with charts.
  • Compound Interest Calculator: how savings grow with compound interest and monthly contributions, with a chart.
  • CD Calculator † and Roth IRA Calculator †: what a CD or a Roth IRA is worth at the end, with charts.
  • Retirement Age Calculator †: your Social Security full retirement age and the time left.
  • Sales Tax Calculator †, Percent Off Calculator †, Tip Calculator † and Profit Margin Calculator †: everyday price arithmetic with the working shown.

Health

  • BMI Calculator: body mass index, its category and the healthy weight range for your height.
  • BMR Calculator: basal metabolic rate by Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict or Katch-McArdle, with daily Calories at five activity levels and a plain-language “What this means” note.
  • Calorie Calculator: a daily Calorie target to lose, keep or gain weight at the rate you pick, with a warning if it’s too low.
  • Calories Burned Calculator †: Calories burned walking, cycling, running, swimming and more, from official MET values.
  • Weight Loss Calculator †: the date you’d reach a goal weight on a daily Calorie target, week by week as the loss slows, and the percentage of body weight lost.
  • Steps to Miles Calculator † and Steps to KM Calculator †: steps to distance from your height or step length.
  • Due Date Calculator: due date and how far along, from the last period, conception date or IVF transfer.
  • Ovulation Calculator: fertile window, ovulation day and next period, for the next three cycles.

Sports

  • Golf Handicap Calculator †: a Handicap Index from up to 20 scores by the World Handicap System, and a Course Handicap.
  • Pace Calculator †: running pace from distance and time, or the time or distance from a pace, with splits.

Games

  • CPS Test †: a click speed test over 1 to 100 seconds, plus clicks per second from any count and time.

Music

  • BPM Calculator †: tap tempo, BPM from a beat count, average BPM and note lengths in milliseconds.
  • Metronome †: a metronome with accents, subdivisions and tap tempo, played in the browser.

Each shows its working step by step, in US or metric units where that applies. More calculators from calculatorbar.com are added over time.

Languages: English, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Western Punjabi (Shahmukhi), Urdu, German, Indonesian and Korean, for the 16 calculators without a †. The calculators follow your site’s language automatically, or you can pick one under Settings → Calculator Galore. Arabic, Punjabi and Urdu display right to left. The calculators marked † are in English for now: on a site in another language they show in English, and translations will follow in later updates.

The calculators run entirely in the visitor’s browser. They send no data anywhere, set no cookies and load nothing from other sites. They take their fonts, colours, fields and buttons from your theme, so they look like part of your site. If your theme’s form styling doesn’t suit them, switch to the Card style.

The formulas, worked examples and sources are explained on calculatorbar.com, the site these calculators come from.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  2. Add the Calculator Galore block to a page and pick a calculator in its settings, or use a shortcode such as [calculatorgalore calc="scientific"], [calculatorgalore calc="mortgage"] or [calculatorgalore calc="bmi"]. Settings → Calculator Galore lists every calculator with its shortcode.
  3. Optional: Settings → Calculator Galore to pick units, style, tabs and header, and to turn the credit link on.
sections.faq:
Can I show metric units first?

For the calculators that ask for height and weight, yes: units="metric" in the shortcode, the block’s settings, or the site-wide default under Settings → Calculator Galore.

It doesn’t look right with my theme

Switch Style to Card: a clean white card with its own fields and button. Site-wide under Settings → Calculator Galore, per block, or with style="card". The Accent colour setting changes the highlight colour in either style.

Can I change the tabs or add a header?

Yes. Choose Underline, Pill or Segmented tabs, and turn on a coloured header with the calculator’s name. Per calculator: the block’s settings, or tabs="pill" header="yes" in the shortcode.

Which language do the calculators use?

Your site’s language (Settings → General → Site Language) if it’s one of the 14, otherwise English. To choose a different one, go to Settings → Calculator Galore → Language. All calculators on the site use the same language.

Can I put several calculators on one page?

Yes, different ones. Each calculator can appear once per page.

Does it add a link to my site?

Only if you choose. After activation the plugin asks once whether to show a small “… calculator by Calculator Bar” link under each calculator, to calculatorbar.com. It’s off unless you click “Yes, show it”, and you can change it any time under Settings → Calculator Galore.

Is this medical advice?

No. The health calculators give estimates, and each says so. For pregnancy dates, a due date from a doctor or midwife (usually from an ultrasound) takes priority.

Got feedback?

Email ezra@calculatorgalore.com and tell us where you’re using the calculators. We’ll send you a coffee on us.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • 5 more calculators, for 59 in all: area, weight loss, a CPS (click speed) test, BPM and a metronome. English for now.
  • Volume and slope calculators: a drawing of the shape, or a graph of the points and line, that redraws as you type, in your theme’s colours.
  • Volume, slope and weight loss update the answer as you type.
  • Retirement age: milestone dates stay on one line.

1.1.1

  • The optional credit link now reads “… calculator by Calculator Bar” and links to calculatorbar.com.

1.1.0

  • 38 more calculators, for 54 in all: graphing, fraction, decimal to fraction, average, standard deviation, GCF, LCM, factoring, square root, slope and volume; age and time card; weighted grade and final exam; cubic yard, gravel, mulch, paint, tile, fence, roof pitch and board foot; mortgage, personal loan, HELOC, CD, Roth IRA, retirement age, sales tax, percent off, tip and profit margin; calories burned, steps to miles and steps to km; golf handicap and pace.
  • The new calculators are in English for now. On a site in another language they show in English, while the first 16 stay translated.
  • The block’s menu lists the calculators in category order, and Settings → Calculator Galore groups them by category with their shortcodes.

1.0.1

  • GPA calculator: add semesters, with a GPA for each and an overall GPA.
  • Scientific calculator: a Table tab for tables of values. Type f(x), a start, a step and up to 50 rows, and pick any x to see its working. Translated into every language.
  • Translations: corrected about 1,000 mistranslated calculator messages across the 13 languages, and the Bengali Clear button now reads the same on every calculator.

1.0.0

  • First release: 16 calculators (scientific, percentage, proportion, ratio, amortization, compound interest, date, time duration, concrete, square footage, GPA, BMR, BMI, calorie, due date and ovulation), in 14 languages.
